before: The private row planner carried blank rows and scalar cell values, without rich new cell fragments or explicit row height.
after: A pure planner carries new cell AST streams, exact row height, and owned payload bindings. Native previews validate physical cell count, merge continuations, locks, and storage. A test-only immutable oracle verifies native insertion and save/reopen.
reason: Planning changes no live document or shared format. Executors must allocate native IDs after row creation and revalidate the canonical revision. A01/R08 retain actual guarded mutations and their two-session verification. No publishable package code changes.
